title: Qwen3.8 Max pairs a one-million-token context with mid-tier pricing
friendlyTitle: Qwen3.8 Max handles very large files at a reasonable price
summary: Independent testing from Artificial Analysis gives Qwen3.8 Max an Intelligence Index score of 58, with image and video input, a one-million-token context window and API pricing of $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens. The model ranked strongly on intelligence but was relatively verbose and slightly slower than the comparison median.
friendlySummary: Independent tests show Qwen3.8 Max is a strong model with a very large memory window. It can read text, images and video, but it often writes long answers.
whyItMatters: The model is a credible option for large-document and multimodal workflows, but its high output volume can increase real task costs. Teams should compare cost per completed job, not just the attractive headline token price.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It may suit big research or document tasks. Check the total cost of its long answers before using it at scale.
